notes.title: Update 1.1 is Out!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Update 1.1 is now available!  We fixed a lot of little things and a few big things.

This update features:
[list]
    [*]Updated Localization - noticed we had some incorrect translations in the game.  All languages have been updated and checked by human translators.
    [*]Fixed a black screen issue if you closed the spinner during a spin.
    [*]Re-balanced handful of levels to make more appropriate.  May be doing more of this in the near future if levels need adjustments.
    [*]Fixed wording on failed dialog.
    [*]Fixed combo messages to show up more frequent and better alignment.
    [*]Fixed a misspelling.
    [*]Build is now 32-bit supported.  Sorry for those who expected that.  Now it's 32-bit supported.
[/list] 

I hope everyone is enjoying the game!  Please leave any feedback on the message board or in a review and I will certainly appreciate it.

Kind Regards,
RedZone Studios LLC
